description: Akroma Plaza Hotel is situated in the Chapel Hill area of Takoradi, close to the city centre, airport, harbour, and Market Circle. The hotel provides a convenient conference setting with event facilities, hospitality services, guest rooms, restaurant, gym, pool, and business-friendly amenities.
